TLC and Salt-N-Pepa are bringing the party on the road in 2026 with the IT'S ICONIC Tour, joined by special guests En Vogue.

subtitle.simpleText: Meet Lynn Gunn, the front woman of PVRIS. In 2014, the band released their debut album 'White Noise' to critical acclaim, landing on the Billboard 200 and catapulting the New England-born alternative act into the mainstream music scene. But for PVRIS, the success didn't happen overnight. Join us for our third installment of HOME STRETCH: PVRIS, as we head back to Lowell, Massachusetts to learn more about front woman Lynn's story and the band's origins. Episode 1 out Thursday, 4/3 at 9:30am PT / 12:30pm ET Episode 2 out Thursday, 4/10 at 9:30am PT / 12:30pm ET Episode 3 out Thursday, 4/17 at 9:30am PT / 12:30pm PT See PVRIS live: https://livemu.sc/pvris2025
